models.name: soft_dollar_client_report
models.label: Soft-dollar commissions
models.description: One row per trade with the commission earned and the soft-dollar share credited to the client.

columns.name: client_id
columns.description: Client the trade belongs to. Used by the server to scope every query; never shown to users.

columns.name: trade_date
columns.description: Date the trade was executed.

columns.name: symbol
columns.description: Ticker of the traded security.

columns.name: commission
columns.description: Gross commission charged on the trade, in USD.

columns.name: soft_dollar_amount
columns.description: Portion of the commission credited to the client as soft dollars, in USD.

columns.name: net_amount
columns.description: Commission after the soft-dollar credit, in USD.

columns.name: broker_notes
columns.description: Internal free-text notes from the trading desk.

models.name: client_positions_report
models.label: Client positions
models.description: End-of-day holdings per client, one row per security.

columns.name: client_id
columns.description: Client that holds the position. Used by the server to scope every query; never shown to users.

columns.name: as_of_date
columns.description: Business date of the snapshot.

columns.name: symbol
columns.description: Ticker of the security held.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Number of shares or contracts held at close.

columns.name: market_value
columns.description: Value of the position at the closing price, in USD.

models.name: commission_summary
models.label: Commissions summary
models.description: Commissions rolled up per trading desk and security, with rebates and fees.

columns.name: client_id
columns.description: Client the summary row belongs to. Used by the server to scope every query; never shown to users.

columns.name: trade_date
columns.description: Date the commissions were incurred.

columns.name: desk
columns.description: Trading desk that executed the trades, for example Cash or Options.

columns.name: symbol
columns.description: Ticker of the traded security.

columns.name: gross_commission
columns.description: Commission before rebates and fees, in USD.

columns.name: rebates
columns.description: Rebates returned to the client, in USD.

columns.name: fees
columns.description: Fees charged on the trades, in USD.

columns.name: net_commission
columns.description: Commission after rebates and fees, in USD.

models.name: security_master
models.label: Security master
models.description: Reference data describing each security. The same for every client.

columns.name: symbol
columns.description: Ticker of the security. Join key to the other datasets.

columns.name: sector
columns.description: Industry sector, for example Technology or Financials.

columns.name: exchange
columns.description: Exchange the security is listed on.
